research_question: How can satellite-derived size-partitioned phytoplankton carbon concentrations be retrieved to constrain global ocean biogeochemical models?

phase_1.user_prompt: I am working on constraining a global ocean inverse model of the coupled iron, phosphorus, and silicon cycles. I need to find the PANGAEA dataset containing satellite estimates of size-partitioned phytoplankton carbon concentrations published by Kostadinov et al. (2016). Could you identify the PANGAEA dataset DOI/ID and list the three phytoplankton size classes provided?

phase_2.user_prompt: Using the PANGAEA identifier 10.1594/PANGAEA.859005, please retrieve the dataset record so we can access the data links and metadata for the size-partitioned phytoplankton carbon concentrations.
